summary: @or-sdk/base 0.44.5 ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (hex identifiers, dictionary-lookup dispatch) and, on install, downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts and chmod+x's the `bun` binary, then invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line shuffled-string-array obfuscated blob (WV8StW rotator + n7gIxM array, `// @bun @bun-cjs` marker), has no source-tree counterpart in src/, and is undocumented in CHANGELOG. The advertised package purpose is an axios-based HTTP client SDK for onereach.io; prior versions up through 0.44.3 shipped only that SDK content with no Bun usage and no math_init payload. Version 0.44.5 adds the preinstall hook, setup.mjs, and math_init.js with no corresponding CHANGELOG entry. Executing an opaque 727KB payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at install time bypasses Node-based scanners and is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern; the mismatch between the SDK's stated purpose and the smuggled payload, plus obfuscation of both the loader and the payload, indicates a compromised release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
